name: Cells
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of all life, forming man from the dust and breathing into him the breath of life, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). Man is uniquely created in God's own image, male and female, and is commanded to be fruitful and multiply, exercising dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:27-28). The intimate care of God over human life is evident even before birth, as He forms and covers the individual in the mother's womb (Psalms 139:13), underscoring the sacredness of life at its earliest stages, which relates directly to the significance of cells and stem cells as part of God's design.
